title: Warm Lo-Fi Music Bed
tests: Checks whether the delivered music matches the stated mood, genre and duration without unnecessary clarification.

faults.what: The audio lasts 15 seconds, exceeding the requested 10 seconds by 5 seconds.
The transcription reports the audible word "Wiedersehen", violating the no-vocals requirement.

judge.summary: An audio file was delivered, but it is 15 seconds long and contains a spoken word despite the request for a 10-second instrumental bed.

must_haves.item: One playable music audio file is delivered.
must_haves.why: The supplied sound report identifies lofi_music_bed.wav with a measured duration and peak level.

must_haves.item: The audio lasts 10 seconds, within 0.1 second.
The music has a recognizable laid-back hip-hop beat and mellow lo-fi texture.
must_haves.why: The sound report does not describe the beat or texture, and the audio cannot be heard.

must_haves.item: The overall mood is warm and relaxed rather than tense or high-energy.
must_haves.why: The mood cannot be established from the supplied sound report.

must_haves.item: No singing or spoken words are audible.
must_haves.why: The sound transcription explicitly reports speech: "Wiedersehen".
